pages.text:
The Chemical Reactor reacts up to two items and up to three fluids into an item, a fluid, or both. Three input tanks, one output tank, two item slots in and an item slot out, plus a byproduct slot.
# Sulfur
- Crush gunpowder (2 Sulfur Dust each), netherrack (sometimes a Sulfur Dust) or Nether Sulfur Ore, found through the Nether.
- Sulfur Dust + 500 mB Water makes 500 mB Sulfuric Acid.
# Leaching (×3)
- Raw ore + 250 mB Sulfuric Acid (or Hydrochloric Acid) makes 300 mB of that metal's Slurry. An ore block takes 500 mB and makes 600 mB; a raw ore block, 2,250 and 2,700.
- Works for iron, copper, gold, silver, nickel, tungsten and bismuth. Fluorite and arcite are gems and aren't leached.
# Precipitating
- 100 mB Slurry + 100 mB Water makes one dust, with a small chance of Slag.
- So a raw ore gives 3 dust and an ore block 6, against 2 and 4 from the Arc Crushing Array.
# Setting up
Fluids go into whichever input tank already holds them, otherwise an empty one; items the same way into the two item slots. Run one reactor for acid, one for leaching and one for precipitating, joined with fluid conduits.
# Plastic
- 100 mB Light Oil + 50 mB Hydrogen makes 2 Plastic Sheets.
# Farm chemistry
NPK Fertilizer, Nutrient Solution and Biodiesel: see NPK Fertilizer in Farming. Brine, Hydrochloric Acid and the Lye biodiesel: see Salt & Chlor-Alkali.
